principle_violations.reason: The pay method combines payment processing logic with order state management, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate payment processing into a dedicated PaymentProcessor class to handle various payment methods, keeping the Order class focused on order management.

principle_violations.reason: The pay method requires modifications to add new payment types, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a strategy pattern for payment methods, allowing new payment types to be added without modifying the existing Order class.
